course.title: L40 Reading, Record, and Requests
course.description: 用阅读材料和记录场景练观点、页面、印刷、散文、问题、阅读、原因、记录、宗教和请求。 场景：学员读一页材料，里面有问题、原因、观点、请求、记录、散文和宗教讨论。 目标词：opinion, page, print, prose, question, reading, reason, record, religion, request。核心句型：I have ... / What is your ...? / Give me ... / Put ... on ... / ... is on/in/about/for ... / ... has ...。
